text: Entry 1307 removes google_token_type and the calendar token-inventory collector as no longer needed. It removes only the inventory assertions and calendar registration from the CalDAV OAuth tests; the request and stored-login behavior remain. Source study B’s exact byte proof shows the whole 1307 test file matches the original 1173 parent, while the other files have intervening changes and are not whole-file inverse proofs. The accepted test still verifies a Bearer authorization header. Treat the token inventory as historical; do not infer a token migration decision or authentication removal. No OAuth or telemetry test was run, and the bug/review discussion is pending.
title: Removing Google token-format telemetry preserves the OAuth request tests
